notes.title: UPDATE IS ALREADY AVAILABLE 0.11
DEVELOPMENT OF UPDATE 0.11
DEVELOPMENT OF UPDATE 0.11
notes.content:
There have been no posts for a long time. But this is due to a lot of added and recycled gameplay elements, mechanics, and more.
The update will be released very soon, even before the end of the summer sale. Now I am preparing and assembling everything, but not everything was able to be done as planned. The rest of the content will be added every week throughout July.

The update size will be about 1.5 gigabytes, which is twice the size of the game itself. A lot has been done, including I have organized a reserve for multiplayer. But again, not everything could be done even in 3 months of development due to the many details.

The main feature will be a complete update of the visual part. The system requirements will be increased, but this increase is not based on an empty place. The game now features highly polygonal models, high-resolution textures, infinite drawing range, and support for Path Tracing (still in beta mode. There are small artifacts in the menu).

Almost all geometry is now calculated on the video card, each element in the game that you will see has its own real geometry, and is not processed using translucent planes, as is usually done. Every blade of grass, every leaf on the tree is a real geometry.
The textures of objects and shadows are now divided into viral maps, which allows you to save a lot of video memory without compromising quality.
The navigation system has also been improved, but I do not plan to implement it yet, as I will need to determine the processor load. At the moment, the game has a navigation system from the previous version, but it has been slightly improved due to the static navigation grid. If earlier it was calculated only around the character and the enemies could not move freely around the map, now I will chase you no matter how fast and how far you run, they will always find you.

A lot of gameplay mechanics have also been redesigned, but this will be discussed in the following posts.

notes.title: Development of update 0.11
Development of update 0.11
notes.content:
- Beetles are now represented by several subspecies in each of the species.
- The types of enemies vary from planet to planet, but the number of species is always limited to two or three (not including special individuals).
- Each subspecies will be different due to its abilities.
- The appearance of all enemies has now been redesigned. The number of geometries has been increased and all textures have been redrawn.
- Beetles now do not appear out of nowhere, but crawl out of their nests.
- Nests can always be destroyed completely and get rid of enemies in a certain area.
- Nests grow over time, even when the player is not around, this must be taken into account.
- The size of the beetles now depends on the nest itself. The size is always individual and affects health, speed and attack.
- Removed bio-mass that dropped out of enemies. This element is outdated and will be replaced by other mechanics.

These are not all changes regarding bugs, the rest still needs to be tested and worked out to say for sure that they will be in the game.

I'll tell you about transport tomorrow.

notes.title: Development of update 0.11
notes.content:
- Outposts will be the main link in the whole new gameplay chain.
- Tasks and various activities will be associated with them.
- They will always be in the same places, but with each new start of the level you will always find them in different states.
- Outposts can be invaded by pirates or bugs.
- The player can almost always restore their functionality.
- 80% of all buildings are generated inside outposts.
- Outposts and buildings will require energy.
- The functional buildings inside them will always be different.

notes.title: Development of update 0.11
notes.content:
The update will change almost the entire game and will be focused on a third-person shooter, but the idea will remain the same.

Details are coming soon.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.10
DEV NEWS #2
notes.content:
I'm continuing to work on 0.10.

The new update should be one of the largest. A new mode will be added, new gameplay features, some resources have been redesigned, the economy has been updated, the balance has been redesigned, the main lobby and interface design have been changed. I decided to apply a number of non-standard solutions for this genre. We'll see what happens, but the players obviously don't expect it.

This update will be a preparation for version 0.11 or 0.12, in which it is planned to expand the plot and add mechanics that it was decided to abandon earlier.

In addition, I am conducting initial preparation of the multiplayer and testing whether it will be possible to do it at all, since replication is a very difficult task, especially if it is done efficiently. It is further complicated by the fact that the game was originally made with the expectation of a single game. And if you remember the moment even earlier, then it was only for mobile devices. In general, if replication is terrible, then there will be no multiplayer.

For the sake of innovations, you have to turn a blind eye to minor bugs that do not affect the game in any way, but sometimes catch your eye (for example, shadows in the distance sometimes appear too sharply). I remember about them and will fix them as soon as possible. This has to be done because of the lack of time between updates.

Approximately the update should be released on the 20th of February.

notes.title: DEV NEWS #1
notes.content:
I am continuing to work on the update 0. 09, which should bring new elements of development and changes to the economy. 

It is planned to add something like a "farm" on the spacecraft so that alien plants can be grown for sale and breeding. In addition, new crystals can be displayed on the farm, which are required to improve the character's equipment. 

The characteristics of the new devices will change and the old devices that have existed since the very first Alpha version will be redesigned, without changes. Their balance will be carried out, and in some cases, a complete reworking of the functionality. 

Minor improvements will also be added that will enhance the gaming experience. 

If there is time left, then I will finally add new achievements for the second planet, which has existed for a long time without them. It is also planned to rework the training, which in its current form does not inform the player much about existing opportunities. Eg: how to discover a new planet, a new character and where to find new crystals.

And I would like to solve the long-standing problem of the player "wandering" around the map, when for new improvements you have to travel too long distances due to the setting and the lore of the game, which disrupts the whole pace. Currently, improvements can only be made in improvement capsules, which are located only near buildings, and buildings are always generated in different places. In general, I am working on this and will try to solve this problem in the future, which will raise the pace and improve the overall impression of the game.

notes.title: Beetle Nest is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone

The long-awaited release took place today, we hope that you will like the game! We are waiting for your ratings and reviews, it is your opinion that we will focus on when creating new content.

Thank you all!

notes.title: The game will be released on Steam soon
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Here we are, getting in touch before the Early Access release. We would like to share our expectations and emotions with you, as this is our first game.

As already mentioned, this is our first game, so we thank in advance all users who decide to purchase the game and will actively participate in the life of the community. Your opinion is very important to us, no matter what it is, as we are always happy with positive feedback. It helps us understand that we are doing everything right and that you really enjoy this game. But we also don't forget about negative feedback. We respect all players who didn't like the game for some reason and we consider any such feedback as an incentive to work on mistakes and move on. We especially appreciate constructive criticism, which allows us to clearly understand what we are doing wrong.

Only 2 people worked on the game and its release, we tried to make a product that you will like and that will occupy at least some niche in its genre, and we really hope that our game will be warmly received. 
We still have a lot of content planned, which we are working on and improving the existing one along the way. Now we are focused on the gameplay component, but we already have a ready-made story that we plan to introduce into the game as soon as we see that there is enough content. In the future, if the community likes the game, we plan to add multiplayer with several modes.

We hope that the story of this game will not end with the release :)

Thanks everyone, see you at the release!
